ITEMISED SUMMARY

Behind every stitch

Our little story

A soft spot for yarn, a love for handmade things, and a whole lot of imagination.

Hi, we're knots & threads

There's magic in making.

Knots & Threads is a crochet studio with a big love for all things handmade, from tiny accessories and cozy home pieces to crochet flowers for florists and events. We believe everyday objects can be a little more joyful, a little more colorful, and a lot more personal.

Our favorite kind of treasure is the kind that looks like someone poured their heart into it — because they did.

“A little yarn, a little patience, a lot of love.” ✿
